## Walkthrough

### Changes

The pull request adds SPARQL scope validation, carrier serialization rules, and blank-node identity handling across RDF storage and evaluation. It also adds portable scope tests and updates scratch-byte accounting and its profile fixtures.

**SPARQL scope and blank-node identity**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Blank-identity primitives and fallible lists** <br> `crates/lex/src/terminals.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/blank_label.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/collections.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/src/ir/*`, `crates/rdf-core/src/dataset_view.rs`, `crates/rdf-core/tests/blank_publication.rs`|Blank-label validation is shared from the lexer. RDF terms and datasets expose stored blank identities, including identities embedded in composite literals. RDF-list construction gains a fallible API.|
|**Algebra scope validation and evidence** <br> `crates/sparql-algebra/src/scope.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/src/validate.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/src/lib.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/tests/scope_*`, `crates/sparql-algebra/tests/support/scope_candidates.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/benches/*`, `crates/sparql-algebra/examples/*`, `docs/design/evidence/scope-investigation.json`, `docs/design/purrdf-sparql-scope.md`, `docs/design/purrdf-simd.md`, `scripts/simd-asm-manifest.toml`|The algebra crate adds typed scope diagnostics and iterative checks for hidden-variable observations, output positions, and blank-label ownership. Candidate checks, tests, benchmarks, and evidence record tested cases and boundaries.|
|**Carrier validation and serialization** <br> `crates/sparql-algebra/src/serialize.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/src/algebra.rs`, `crates/sparql-algebra/tests/scoped_carriers.rs`|Carrier rendering validates representability, refuses concrete blank `VALUES` cells, and assigns aliases or witness variables to preserve blank identities. Tests cover projection, identity, and reparsing behavior.|
|**Evaluation blank identity and minting** <br> `crates/sparql-eval/src/{blank_scope,construct,eval,expr,list_fn,parallel,remote,scratch,template,update,user_fn}.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/src/engine/graph_build.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/scope_interactions.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/governed_*.rs`|Evaluation reserves concrete blank identities and uses collision-aware minting across query, template, update, list, user-function, CONSTRUCT, and SERVICE paths. Tests cover identity separation, mint failures, and scratch-budget outcomes.|
|**Portable scope fixtures and integration checks** <br> `crates/rdf/tests/scope_portable.rs`, `crates/rdf/tests/scope_profiles.rs`, `crates/shapes/tests/scope_profiles.rs`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/fixtures/scope/*`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/scope_interactions.rs`|Portable fixtures define query inputs, datasets, manifests, and expected result bags. Integration tests exercise parsing, execution, retained plans, carriers, normalization, and SHACL constraint admission.|
|**Scratch accounting and governor profile** <br> `crates/sparql-eval/src/{scratch,eval,governor}*`, `docs/SPARQL-GOVERNOR-PROFILE.md`, `crates/sparql-eval/tests/governed_*.rs`, `crates/sparql-conformance/tests/goldens/evaluator-trace/*`, `vectors/sparql-governors/*`, `scripts/conformance-frozen/vectors-sparql-governors.sha256`|Scratch arenas account for retained values and reserved identities through per-arena growth checkpoints. The governor profile advances to version 10, with corresponding tests, traces, and vector expectations.|
